title: Ministry of Health — Names of licensed clinics, medical centres and health institutions (اسماء العيادات و المراكز الطبية و المؤسسات الصحية المرخصة)
notes: 29 PDFs, one per licence category; this file covers the 20 non-hospital, non-individual-practitioner categories (per file: {'lic_00': 8, 'lic_01': 111, 'lic_02': 3786, 'lic_09': 1, 'lic_10': 21, 'lic_11': 783, 'lic_12': 8, 'lic_13': 142, 'lic_14': 5, 'lic_15': 12, 'lic_16': 177, 'lic_17': 111, 'lic_18': 228, 'lic_19': 66, 'lic_20': 6, 'lic_21': 4, 'lic_22': 33, 'lic_23': 25, 'lic_24': 690, 'lic_25': 83}). NOT included (available in sources/raw/moh_licensed_register): طب إختصاص / طب عام / عيادة عامة / عيادة أسنان (individual doctor and dentist clinics, lic_03..lic_08), hospitals (lic_26, lic_27) and drug warehouses (lic_28). EXTRACTION: the PDFs are Word exports whose Arabic is stored in visual order and, in several files (e.g. private labs, charity labs, dental clinics), with a ToUnicode map shifted against Arial's Arabic Presentation Forms-B glyph layout (ق came out as ل, ي as tanween, lam-alef split). Text was rebuilt per table cell from glyph ids (gid = codepoint - 64256, validated per font: 100% agreement on unaffected letters) and characters sorted right-to-left per line with digit/Latin runs re-reversed; the Allah ligature (glyph 3020, whose text rides on zero-width companions) is restored to الله. Residual risk: the position of numbers relative to Arabic words inside an address can differ from the printed order, and Farsi yeh/heh glyphs (ی/ھ) were normalised to ي/ه. Script: build-time licpdf.py. Phones are as printed, without area code or leading zero; values printed in Excel scientific notation (e.g. 7.77E+08, digits lost) were dropped and kept in extra.phone_raw_unusable. The dental-centre file has a MOBILE_NO column which was dropped (personal mobiles). Trade names sometimes include the licensee's name, as printed. Ownership is set only where the category states it (private lab = private, charity lab = ngo); "عامة" for pharmacies means a community pharmacy, not government. For the "مركز متخصص" category, type is imaging_center / dialysis_center only when the trade name itself says radiology/imaging or dialysis (غسيل/ديال - kidney-surgery/urology centres are NOT dialysis and stay clinic) (flag extra.type_from_name_keyword); otherwise clinic. duty_ar for pharmacies is the printed المناوبة value (عادية / لغاية 12 ليلا / 24 ساعة). Register date is not printed; PDFs were current on the MoH site at retrieval.
